paite: "Pathian aw, nang na hon khahkhia a, na hon hihsia a; na hong hehta a; hon tungding nawn in aw.
heading: David La / Suahtakna Dia Thumna Aram Naharaim Leh Aram Zobah Toh Akidou Lai Ua, Joab In Ahong Kik Nawn Lam A Chikhuk Phaizang A Edom Mi Singkhat-le-sangnih Athah Lai A
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

paite: Hiai gam na hihling a, na khangsakta hi; akhangkhamte siam hoih nawn inla; aling aling ngal a.
english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

paite: Na mite thil haksa pipi na tuaksak a hoina uain na hon dawnsak hi.
english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

paite: Nang laudan siamte kiang ah puanzak na peta a, thutak ziak a zak ahihtheihna ding in. Selah
english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

paite: Na deihtakte humbit a a-om theihna ding un, na khut taklam in hon hondam inla, hon dawng in.
english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

paite: "Pathian in asianthouna ah hichibang in agen, ka nuam ding a; Shekem khua ka hawm ding a, Sukkoth phaizang ka hawmzak ding hi.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

paite: Gilead gam kei a ahi a, Manasseh gam kei a ahi a; Ephraim gam leng ka lu humbitna ahi a; Judah gam ka lalchiang ahi.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

paite: Moab gam ka kisilna bel ahi; Edom gam ah khedap ka pai ding, Philistia gam, nang zaw keimah ziak in kikou tanla, chi in.
english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

paite: "Khopi kiptak ah kua'n ahon pilut dia! Edom gam ah kua'n a hon pi ding!
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

paite: Pathian aw, nangmah mah in na hon deih louh ka hi kei ua hia? Pathian aw, ka sepaihte kiang uah lah na pawt ngal ta kei a.
english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

paite: Melmate sual ding in hon panpih in, mihing panpihna bangmah lou maimai ahi ngal a.
english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

paite: Pathian ziak in hangsantak in ka hih ding; amah tuh i melmate sikden dingpa ahi ngal a."
english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
